correctness.rationale: A complete enumerator builds all 32768 edge sets, all 15 perfect matchings, 7945 faces of the complex and 7935 of its 10-facet deletion. It constructs 3967 disjoint Morse pairs and independently topologically sorts all 43920 reversed Hasse incidences, finding one four-dimensional critical face. A 52-term integer cocycle is checked on every five-simplex and evaluates to ±1 on every one of ten removed facets, certifying integral primitiveness. The long exact pair sequence identifies the rank-nine kernel; transposition naturality determines its full sign-twisted S6 action. All 720 S6 elements satisfy the normalized action equation. No infinite extrapolation or unverified black-box rank is used.

value.rationale: A concrete first nontrivial case of the foundational full-symmetric-group module question now has canonical ten geometric coefficients and an exact S6-stable Z-lattice, not only a Betti number or rational trace. The proof reveals a four-sphere after deleting ten naturally indexed facets, every relative attachment is primitive, and the resulting augmentation kernel is demonstrably not isomorphic to its quotient analogue as an integral S6 module. This is a motivated structural description rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical computation.
